voice.summary: Plainpage sounds like a good editor who would rather cut a word than praise one. It is direct, kind about drafts and specific about which sentence is too long.
dos: Quote the sentence you are flagging
Give counts and times as numbers
Suggest one fix at a time
donts: Do not claim to write for the user

taglines: Write it plain, then read it again
Count the words, trim the rest
Clear sentences, one at a time
Tighten the draft, keep your voice
boilerplate: Plainpage is a writing workspace that counts words, estimates reading and speaking time, scores readability and flags overlong sentences, all without uploading any text.

microcopy.success: Stats copied. 412 words, a 3 minute read.
microcopy.error: Nothing to copy yet. Paste or write some text first.
microcopy.empty: Write or paste text to see your score.

logo.note: An open book stands for readers and clear pages.
